parameters.content:
# 🍽️ RestoFlow — Restaurant Operations Engine

**Client:** La Tavola — Trattoria Italienne, Lyon (Cordeliers)
**Owner:** Marco
**Capacity:** 55 covers + 20 terrace

8 modules • AI Voice Agent • WhatsApp Bot • CRM • Loyalty • Reviews • Smart Promos • Daily Briefing

**Infra cost:** ~€44/month | **AI Models:** GPT-5, GPT-4.1-nano, Claude 4.6 Sonnet

## 📞 M1 — AI VOICE AGENT

Vapi.ai picks up every call 24/7 in natural French.

**Handles:** Reservations (checks real-time availability), FAQs (hours, parking, menu du jour), takeaway redirect to WhatsApp.

**Transfers to Marco:** Complaints, group events, complex questions.

**Impact:** 100% answer rate (was 65%). ~€2,800/month recovered.

## 📅 M2 — NO-SHOW KILLER

WhatsApp confirmation sequence:
• J-1 at 18h → ✅ Confirm / ❌ Cancel / 🔄 Modify
• J-0, 2h before → gentle reminder (if no reply)
• No-show → gentle next-day message

**Slot Recovery:** Cancellation → waitlist notified → first to reply gets the table.

**Repeat offenders:** Flagged after 2 no-shows. Banned? Never automatic — Marco decides.

**Impact:** No-shows 18% → 5%. ~€4,200/month recovered.

## 📱 M3 — WHATSAPP BOT

The restaurant's second waiter. Available 24/7.

**Menu-driven:** 1️⃣ Reserve 2️⃣ Menu 3️⃣ Order takeaway 4️⃣ Info 5️⃣ Talk to Marco
**Free-text:** GPT-4.1-nano classifies intent → auto-response or human handoff.
**Takeaway:** Full ordering flow + Stripe payment + kitchen notification + "Your order is ready!" alert.

**Key win:** Direct orders bypass UberEats' 30% commission.

**Impact:** ~€1,200/month in saved commissions.

## 👥 M4 — CRM & CLIENT INTELLIGENCE

Zero manual data entry. Built automatically from every interaction.

**Tracks:** Visit count, total spent, avg ticket, favorite dishes, preferred day, allergies, no-show history, loyalty tier.

**VIP Alerts:** "Pierre D. booked tonight. 14th visit. Likes Barolo. Nut allergy."
**Birthday Detection:** Weekly scan → Marco approves dessert offer.
**Disappearing Regulars:** "Sophie hasn't visited in 35 days (usually every 14). Win-back?"

## 🏆 M5 — LOYALTY ENGINE

No app to download. No stamp card to lose. Everything via WhatsApp.

**Points:** 10 per visit. 1 per € on WhatsApp orders.
**Tiers:** 🥉 Bronze → 🥈 Silver (-10%) → 🥇 Gold (free dessert) → 💎 VIP (-15% + priority table)
**Referral:** +100 points when a friend visits.

Customer texts 'POINTS' → gets their card with progress bar.

**Impact:** +20% visit frequency for loyalty members. ~€2,000/month.

## ⭐ M6 — REVIEW GUARDIAN

Google Places API polled every 6h.

• ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ → Claude 4.6 Sonnet drafts warm thank-you → Marco approves on Slack
• ⭐⭐⭐ → Empathetic draft → HUMAN REVIEW mandatory
• ⭐⭐/⭐ → 🚨 URGENT Slack + SMS to Marco → draft NEVER auto-published

**Review solicitation:** 3h after visit (only for 2+ visit clients). Max 1/month.

**Impact:** 4.2 → 4.5 stars in 4 months. ~€1,500/month in new customers.

## 📢 M7 — SMART CAMPAIGNS

Every Monday: occupancy analysis for the week.
If a night is < 50% → Slack alert to Marco:
"📊 Tuesday: 8/22 tables (36%). Launch promo?"

If approved → GPT-5 generates personalized WhatsApp messages.
**Anti-spam:** Max 2 promos/client/month. STOP to unsubscribe.

**Impact:** Tuesday/Wednesday nights: 36% → 65% occupancy.

## 📊 M8 — OWNER DASHBOARD

**Daily (8AM):** WhatsApp briefing to Marco
→ Tonight's bookings + occupancy %
→ Yesterday's revenue
→ VIPs coming tonight
→ Pending reviews & orders

**Weekly (Sunday 8PM):** Full report
→ Revenue, covers, best/worst day, no-show rate, trends.

Marco: "For the first time in 6 years, I know what's happening."
